content: Paupuina
Pathian deina bang in Jesus Christ i sawltak keima Paul in, Christ Jesus sungah a thuman le Ephisa a om mithiangtho te:
I Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ kung pan thuthiamna le thinnopna sia note tungah hong om tahen.
Ih Topa Jesus Christ i Pa le Pathian tungah lungdam ko tawng! Banghangziam cile Christ taw kipumkhatna sungah ama in eite sia vantung ngam taw kisai thupha theampo hong pia hi.
Thaa Thupha
Leitung a ki bitphua ma in hong it ahikom Amai ah a thiangtho le paubangngawl i hi thei natu in Christ sungah hong teal zo hi:
Pathian in Ama deina le lungkimna bang in Jesus Christ tungtawn in ta i sua thei natu in hong tealkhol zo hi,
Ama thuthiamna manpha pok tu in a it a Tapa sungah san thei a hi tu in hong vawt zo hi.
A dimlet thuthiamna bang in, Ama sungah Christ thisan tungtawn in tatna le maw maisakna i nei hi;
Ama in eite tungah pilna le heakna theampo hong khangsak zo hi;
Ama sungah a ngealkhol na le a pha a lungkimna bang in, Ama deina thuku sia eite tungah hong hesak hi.
Taciang hunkhenna hun te a cin ciang in vantung na theampo le leitung na theampo te sia a vekpi in Christ sungah ki kaikhawm siat tu hi:
Na theampo sia Ama deina le a ngaisutna bang in vawt a, Ama ngealna bang in hong teal hi, tabang in Ama sungah ngamh i lua zo hi:
Tabang in Christ sungah lametna amasabel a nei eite tungtawn in Pathian minthanna i pok tu hi.
Ama na muang uh a, note tatna lungdamna thupha thuman kammal na zak zawk uh, Ama na up uh ciang kamciam Tha Thiangtho taw hong ciamte zo hi,
Tua Tha Thiangtho sia Ama minthanna pok tu in a leisa nate a tat kik mateng, i lua tu ngamh atu in vaukhaamna a hihi.
Lungdamko le Thungen
Tua ahikom keima zong Jesus Christ sungah na upna uh le mithiangtho te theampo na itna uh thu ka zak zawkciang in,
Note atu in Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko tawntung hi, ka thungetna ah hong hel tawntung khi hi;
Tabang in minthanna i Pa, i Topa Jesus Christ i Pathian in note tungah pilna thaa le Ama heakna sungah thu pualakna hong pia tahen.
Note in Ama sapna i lametna, mithiangtho te i a minthang ngamh le hauna na heak thei natu uh in, na thinsung mit hong vaksak hi,
Taciang Ama vangletna lian nasep ngeina bang in, a um eite tungah Ama vangletna bangza in lian ziam,
Tua vangletna taw Christ sia thina pan thokiksak a, Ama ziatsang vantung ah a koi ciang in Christ sungah a vawt a hihi,
Ama sia thuneina, vangletna, hatna le ukzawkna theampo ahizong, taciang tu hun le hongpai lai tu hun sungah min theampo sang in ahizong, nasiatakin sang zaw hi:
Taciang Ama peangnuai ah na theampo koi siat a, pawlpi i na theampo tungah a lubel dinmun pia hi,
Tasia Ama pumpi hi a, na theampo ah na theampo taw a dimsak tu Ama pilna a hihi.
